text:
jamie.l: Hi all, first day! I clicked the Okta invite but it says 'email not found in directory'. I think I used my personal gmail accidentally during signup. Can we get it fixed?

olivia-peopleops: Welcome, Jamie :tada: We can resend. What address did you sign up with? I'll revoke the old invite and send a new one to your company email.

jamie.l: I used jamie.dev@gmail.com by mistake. Company email is jamie.l@redwood.com. Appreciate the help.

olivia-peopleops: Got it. Revoking old invite now and sending new invite to jamie.l@redwood.com. Watch for two emails (Okta + 1Password). If you don't see them in 5 min, check spam.

okta-bot: Okta invite revoked for jamie.dev@gmail.com. New invite sent to jamie.l@redwood.com. Invite expires in 24h.

jamie.l: I clicked the new invite and it opens the Okta flow, but when I try to set up MFA the browser shows "Passkey setup failed: Unknown error." I'm on macOS Ventura, Chrome 117.

sam-it: Hey Jamie 1: weird but not unheard of. Two quick checks: 1) Try Safari (macOS passkeys are smoother there). 2) Disable any password manager extension briefly (they sometimes intercept auth).

maria-eng: Also if you have an existing Apple passkey tied to a personal iCloud account that can conflict. If Safari prompts to save a passkey use the one linked to your redwood account.

jamie.l: Tried Safari — passkey prompt works but after confirming it redirects back with "unable to verify authenticator". I have a YubiKey but haven't plugged it in yet.

sam-it: Plug in the YubiKey and try a security key flow: in Okta when it errors, choose "Set up a different authenticator" -> "Security Key (U2F)". If that fails, I can SSH into your machine or screen-share.

olivia-peopleops: FYI for 1Password: we auto-provision once Okta shows you as active. If provisioning hangs, reply here and we'll force the SCIM sync.

jamie.l: Plugged YubiKey in and accepted the U2F registration. MFA completed! One last thing: 1Password invite hasn't arrived yet.

okta-bot: Account status: ACTIVE. SCIM provisioning queued.

sam-it: I see the SCIM job completed on our side ~2m ago. Sometimes 1Password emails land as 'noreply@1password' and get filtered. Check Promotions/Updates too. If still nothing in 10m I'll trigger a resend.

maria-eng: Welcome to the team, Jamie! :wave: If you want quick pointers to our dev stack, DM me and I'll drop a doc.

jamie.l: Thanks everyone 1 Worked through it. Appreciate the quick responses.

olivia-peopleops: Great! Marking this thread resolved. If any other onboarding hiccups pop up, ping #new-hires or me directly. :sparkles:
